conversions.rule: text := lastText; occurrence := number of prior same-text words (doc anchor note: w10=充电#0, w11=充电#1). C01's four effects (w04 五分钟, w05 三倍, w14 防水, w19 一万两千六百多件) anchor unique words -> occurrence=0 each; the 充电 disambiguation rule was not exercised by any C01 effect.

startFrame deleted; ALL animations scheduled from t=0 with durationFrames kept. Consequence: three cards scale in simultaneously at F0-F15; headline/CTA entrances finish in the first ~0.4s regardless of their target scene positions.

targetElementId deleted. Builder behavior: counter self-hosts <div id=counter-<fxId>> at canvas origin (0,0), 96px text; highlight applies to the whole #canvas layer. D-01 fixed: digits render on seeked frames (capx pause(t,false)) and counter ink is dark (#2B2118 default, fx.params.color override) instead of .el-text's white-on-cream.

No asset bytes exist in this run and image elements REQUIRE src (Validate rejects empty src), so the image element was removed entirely. Chosen over a fake resolver/data-URI placeholder: lowest implementation cost, and a fake product image would contaminate first-baseline frames.

No asset table, no track model, no render-recipe fields in current IR. Audio set to nil (BGM dropped); DurationFrames stays 450 via meta.durationSec=15 x fps=30. Track layering approximated by element z: bg=0, headline=2, cards/price/cta=10.
Compound keys deleted; cards become plain white rects, CTA becomes a textless orange bar, headline loses bold/centering/line-height control.
conversions.target: compound params keys: mask{roundedRect,rx:32}, title/body/accent (cards), subText/strikeText (price), text/textColor/fontSize/textAlign (cta), fontWeight/textAlign/lineHeight (headline)

conversions.current: Point{x,y} offsets interpreted as (value - element layout position)
conversions.rule: x backfilled with the element's layout x (90) because the current move builder computes from.x - left; a missing x would read as 0 and shift the bar 90px left during the whole tween. Intent-preserving choice, recorded here.
id/confidence/scriptStart/scriptEnd dropped (no fields); all 20 words copied verbatim with their timestamps (aligner/manual source kept).
A fade effect exists in the current registry but is word-anchored and fades a target opacity over 0.6s; the target's frame-based F445 dim has no expressible anchor (last word ends 14.62s). Omitted.

defects.evidence: TestProbeCounterDOMState (testdata/probe_dom_test.go, real browser): pre-fix textContent='' at seeks to 5s/12s/13.5s; pause(12,false) => '8767 件'. Post-fix probe: textContent non-empty at t=12 and 13.5, empty before tween start (5s).
defects.fix: capx: pause(t, false) — server-side seek must fire the same callbacks as live playback. builder: counter host color = fx.params.color || '#2B2118' (dark ink default, readable on light card backgrounds); ir.go validateParams whitelists color for counter params.
defects.found: counter rendered no digits on ANY seeked frame (fixed in this run)
defects.root_cause: platform/capx/renderer.go seekTimeline called tl.pause(tSec) with one argument; GSAP Timeline.pause(atTime, suppressEvents) defaults suppressEvents=true, which skips callbacks (onUpdate/onStart) during the seek render. Second half: counter host inherited .el-text's default white on light backgrounds (contrast ~1.06:1 on VS-C01 cream).
